07/07/2023
Claimant reported a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant is handling the
claim without legal representation and was the driver of the insured vehicle, which is listed on the policy.
07/27/2023
Police attended and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The other driver gave a statement that
mathces the claimant's description of the lane change and contact between the two cars.
09/16/2023
Scene photos and two independent witness statements were obtained and place the impact as the claimant
described. Damage to the claimant's rear quarter panel and the other vehicle's front passenger side appears
consistent with the reported contact.
09/28/2023
Claimant reoprted neck and back strain and was seen at urgent care the same day. The injury is a plausible result of
a sideswipe at this speed, and no prior injury to the neck or back is known from the claimant's records.
10/13/2023
Claimant has described the accident the same way in each call, in the initial report, the recorded statement, and the
follow-up conversation. Nothing has been raised that conflicts with that account.
11/03/2023
Vehicle inspection found no earlier damage to the claimant's car, and nothing in the file suggests the damage
predates the policy's coverage start. The repair estimate lines up with the impact points shown in the photos.
12/20/2023
Treatment has grown well beyond what is typical for this type of strain, with visits now close to daily. Several weeks
after the crash, the calimant began reporting pain in a new body area that was not mentioned at first, and the treating
provider's notes list addtiional referrals.
02/04/2024
File is being referred to the claims review team to examine the scope and timing of the treatment against the injury as
first reported. Liability for the collision is not in question, and the claimant remains cooperative with requests for
records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
